notes: All rates are percent values (7.25 means 7.25%). The evidence package is marked RESEARCH, NOT APPROVED; VERIFIED means read on an official page on 2026-11-16, not approved as a rule.

County tables: the evidence files hold only excerpts, so the same three official files were re-fetched on 2026-11-20 and read by script. Each file's SHA-256 is identical to the hash recorded in the evidence on 2026-11-16.

CA counties: combinedRate is the rate on the 'County' row of the CDTFA table, which is the unincorporated-area rate. Cities inside a county often have a higher rate (up to 11.75% in Lancaster and Palmdale); a county-level estimate can understate the tax for a city address. For Del Norte, Kern, Monterey, Santa Cruz and Yuba the table has no countywide rate, only a 'County Unincorporated Area' row; that row is used.
CA county rates are effective 2026-10-01. District rates can change at any calendar-quarter start; no later change was published as of 2026-11-16.
CA: rate follows the address where the vehicle is registered, not the dealer's location.

CA DMV fees change every January 1. Registration 73 -> 76, CHP 34 -> 35, Road Improvement Fee 121 -> 127, Transportation Improvement Fee 33/66/132/198/231 -> 35/69/138/208/242 on 2027-01-01. The stored main values are the 2026 amounts and expire 2026-12-31.

CA conflict (closed in evidence): the DMV consumer page shows registration 76 with no date while Appendix 1F shows 73; DMV memo VIN 2026-07 shows 73 is current and 76 starts 2027-01-01. The DMV consumer page says use tax '7.25% - 10.25%', out of step with CDTFA's 11.75% maximum.
CA VLF: 0.65% of purchase price (trade-in and rebate not deducted; tax, doc fee and license fees excluded). DMV reads it from a price-bracket table, so price x 0.65% is an approximation.
CA tire fee: 1.75 per new tire including the spare. tiresCharged 5 assumes four tires plus a spare (proposal section 5); a vehicle sold without a spare has four. The fee is not subject to sales tax.
NY counties: combinedRate already includes the 4% state rate and, in MCTD counties, the 0.375% MCTD rate. Do not add either again.
NY: Publication 718 lists 18 cities on their own lines; only Yonkers (8.875%) differs from its county (Westchester 8.375%), so it is the only entry under 'cities'.

NY: the five New York City counties are listed in Publication 718 as 'see New York City' (8.875%). Rate follows the purchaser's residence. The Tax Department says not to use ZIP codes to pick the jurisdiction.
NY: Publication 718 effective 2025-03-01 is the edition listed as current. Many counties' additional local rates are scheduled to expire 2027-11-30 unless extended (NY-DATE-002).
NY registration fee chart is a TWO-YEAR fee by vehicle weight. A minimum of 32.50 applies to vehicles with 6 or more cylinders and to electric vehicles (a floor, not an add-on).

NY countyUseTaxTwoYears: 'amount' is the two-year tax for a vehicle of 3,500 lb or less; 'amountOver3500lb' (added key) is for 3,501 lb or more. Counties not in the list have no use tax row on the DMV chart. mctdFeeTwoYears (50) applies in the 12 counties with mctd true, in addition to any county use tax.

NY tire fee: 2.50 per new tire including spares, extended through 2027-12-31; not subject to sales tax. tiresCharged 5 assumes four tires plus a spare (proposal section 5). inspectionMax 10 is the safety inspection maximum (chart effective 2011-01-01); new vehicles are exempt from the emissions inspection.

FL surtaxRate applies only to the first surtaxCapAmount (5,000) of the sales price; the 6% state rate applies to the whole taxable amount. County is the purchaser's residence address on the title or registration.

FL surtax table is for calendar year 2026 only and expires 2026-12-31. The 2027 table was not published as of 2026-11-16. Surtaxes shown expiring 2026-12-31: Brevard (both .5% parts), Charlotte (1%), Liberty (.5% part), Santa Rosa (one .5% part); those counties' rates may be lower from 2027-01-01.
FL: use dr15dss_26.pdf. The un-suffixed dr15dss.pdf is the 2025 table.

FL title 77.25 is the electronic 'Original New, no lien' total and INCLUDES the 2.00 Lemon Law fee and 4.25 service fee (HSMV 83140 shows the same total as 75.25 + 2.00). Add 2 for a lien, 2.50 for a paper title.

FL registrationByWeight is the class 01 private automobile 'annual tax and other fees' total by net weight (HSMV 83140 Rev. 08/26), not the base tax alone (14.50/22.50/32.50). Full annual amount regardless of month. Trucks use different breaks (see other).

FL initialRegistration 225 applies only when the buyer has no Florida plate to transfer; newPlate 28 only when a new metal plate is issued. tempTag 2 is the statutory fee before the s. 320.04 service charge.
FL conflict (open): the trade-in deduction is worded three ways in official sources (credit / allowance / retail guide value). Not a number in this file.

VA: one statewide motor vehicle sales and use tax of 4.15% with a 75 minimum; no local sales tax on vehicles. The Code carries a 'contingent effective' version (3%, 35 minimum) whose trigger was not retrieved.
VA title fee conflict (open): DMV publishes and charges 15 (titleDmv); Code 46.2-627 says 10 (titleCode). The reconciling provision was not found. Use titleDmv for what a buyer is charged.
VA registrationByWeight is the annual fee from DMV 201 (08/10/2026) for passenger vehicles. highwayUseFeeEv 135.63 is annual, valid 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30; it changes every July 1.
Doc fee caps and planning numbers are not in this file; see section 5 of the proposal.
